correctness.rationale: General-position vertex subsets must be within one multipartite part or select at most one from each part, giving the known exact coefficient formula. Independent symbolic SymPy expansion for every defect k=1..6 shows positive coefficients after the claimed t-4 or t-6 shifts; the tail k>=7 follows from strictly log-concave binomial coefficients. Explicit t=2 and 3 sequences have defects -50 and -240 at the stated indices, yet both are unimodal. The identities, not sampled t, cover all t>=4.
